title: Best Ps5 Pro (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Reviewed the TechRadar, CNET, and The Verge articles that all recommend the PS5 Pro as the best PlayStation 5 machine.

verdict.line: Picture a gamer who wants the best graphics and smoother frame rates on a large TV. The PS5 Pro delivers higher visual fidelity and improved ray‑tracing compared to the standard PS5, making it the top choice for those who value image quality. The catch: it is the most expensive PlayStation ever, costing $700.
